title: Cover Palette
description: Hover or pick any Beatles album and the whole player re-themes from its cover: the colours are pulled from the artwork in a canvas, the page takes the cover's own ground, and every surface, ink and accent slides to its new value through OKLCH. Tap a swatch to copy its hex.
intent: Album art as a live theme source, like a streaming app's album page: the palette is computed, not hand-picked, each role eases on its own lightness, chroma and hue axes, and the ink flips cleanly when the ground crosses from light to dark.
